messages.text: Will one of your milkweeds grow in zone 7?

Hi Kirk,

Sorry for the long wait to get back to you, that's not how we usually operate. To answer your question: all of our milkweed species do well in zone 7, so you have plenty of options. If you're looking for something easy to establish, Swamp milkweed (incarnata) is very forgiving and works in a wide range of conditions. Butterfly milkweed (tuberosa) and Common milkweed (syriaca) are also excellent choices for zone 7.

If it's still relevant, you can browse all our seed varieties here: https://lasclay.com/en/products/milkweed-seeds

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
